title: Dispatch gives free slots to ready tickets of the earliest group in the chain first
objective: When more ready tickets can start than there are free slots, the controller starts those whose group comes earliest in chain.order, and keeps DAG (topo) order among tickets of one group.
outline: devloop/ticket_controller.py, Controller.dispatch (about line 1135). After the adopt() refresh and before the loop, compute the start order once from that snapshot: rank = {gid: n for n, gid in enumerate(chain.order(snap))}; a ticket's key is rank.get(its 'group' or '', len(rank)); iterate sorted(dagmod.topo(snap.dag), key=that) (Python's sort is stable, so topo order holds inside one rank). Look the ticket up with snap.tickets.get(i) or {} so a dag id without a ticket record does not raise (topo lists dag ids, not ticket ids). Keep the order computed once: the loop refreshes snap after every start, but starting an issuer changes no group or chain edge. Everything inside the loop stays as it is: the room/break, the ready and open-group checks, can_start_now, ticketlock.held -> continue, memory_short -> break, make_branch, start_issuer, the refresh. `chain` is already imported in ticket_controller.py (line 62). No change to core/chain.py, core/dag.py or board.py: the board's dag_waits gives every ready ticket with room the same 'next' text and does not predict which one starts first (checked), so no second copy of the rule exists. Docs per A6. Name note: the issue calls the class TicketController; the class is ticket_controller.Controller.

Metric 每張落地票的 token 與時間 (time): for the urgent group, time to landing drops by up to the run time of the later-group tickets that took its slots (with max_parallel 2, about one or two issuer rounds); also 等我處理的事積了多少, since an urgent fix the main session reordered no longer waits behind later groups. request:
Fix GitHub issue sai99claw/agent-control#17 (source: issue #17, reported from tabby_pool).

Problem (confirmed in code): `TicketController.dispatch` in devloop/ticket_controller.py iterates ready tickets in
`dagmod.topo(snap.dag)` order only. It ignores the group chain (`chain.order(snap)`). When the main session orders
groups with `actl dag after` / `dag dep` so that an urgent group comes first, the controller can still fill every
slot (max_parallel) with tickets of later groups while the first group's ready tickets wait. The first group cannot
start its regression until its own tickets are done, so the urgent fixes land last.

Wanted: when choosing which ready tickets to start, order candidates by the position of their group in
`chain.order(snap)` first (groups not in the chain after all chained groups), then by the existing topo order inside
a group. Everything else in dispatch stays the same (can_start_now, ticket locks, memory_short, max_parallel).

One ticket. Acceptance: with max_parallel smaller than the ready tickets, a ready ticket of the first chained group
starts before ready tickets of later groups even when those have lower ticket ids / earlier topo position; inside a
group topo order still holds.

vision: dispatch follows the order the main session set for groups, so the group that must land first gets slots first.
removes: nothing (replaces the plain topo iteration in dispatch with chain-then-topo ordering).
